You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

The patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in `drivers/staging/greybus/light.c`. The modification reorders the assignment of `light->channels_count` to occur only after the successful allocation of the `light->channels` array. Previously, `channels_count` was set before calling `kcalloc()`, so if the allocation failed, the cleanup path in `gb_lights_release()` would iterate `channels_count` (non-zero) and dereference the still-NULL `channels` pointer. By moving the assignment after the allocation, the cleanup path will see `channels_count` as zero if the allocation fails, preventing the NULL dereference. This is a single-file change with no cross-file relationships; the fix ensures safe error handling within the same struct initialization sequence.
